1945 August 18
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey O. F.M. Cap.
St. Michael's Church 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, N. Y. August 18, 1945
Miss Muriel Krausman Allen Park. Mich.
Dear Miss Krausman:
God bless you all-you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of a few weeks back. I hope you enjoyed your vacation-you and your Father. I started to fix up a big card-certificate for the Poor Souls to sent your Mother but was not certain about her first name, so let it go. I am not sure if I sent your Brother-in-law certificates. Its taken me so far pretty much to get acquainted with the work, etc here. Today five of us go up to the Immaculate Conception Monastery across from West Point, to make our annual retreat. In other words we'll try a- gain to be converted for another year.
So I hope you'll pardon neglect and brevity. God bless and guide you and us all.
Sincerely in the Sacred Heart,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
P.S .- had to open envelope to say -- The double relic ought to, ought to work something for little Juda. The white partical is of the linen shroud of Venerable Mary of Agreda, Spain, who after 249 years was ex- umed and found perfectly preserved. She had been our Bl. Mother's secretary in the writing "The City of God" autobiography.
